Messages.Author: Daniel Figueiredo
Messages.Body:
I was reading the spoilers for the baali vampires and I came to the
conclusion that the rare 10 cap baali is actually the worst of the 5!
Really, who cares if he has 6 superiors?? Does anyone use 6
disciplines in a deck? 5? not may decks even have 4... and with the
baali so ties in with the FoS, it wont be easy to fit a 10cap infernal
guy into other decks, now will it? If he had SER, then he would be
very usefull to the setites. But plus one bleed and having to PAY a
pool to get another master.. mmm... and another pool to untap him...
mmm... in a setite deck even Sarrasine would be more useful for the
extra master, and you´re not exactly hurting for +1 bleed when you
have presence as an in-clan... Just to clarify, this is not a rant,
just my trying to say that the 10 cap rare guy is, in my opinion the
worst of the 5 baali in bloodlines. The 5 cap gets you the edge even
when hunting and has +1 strength to boot, the 7 cap lets you discard
like hell and makes people pay to block you, the other 7 cap strikes
for aggravated, the 8 cap has ser, reduces only your prey´s hand and
can get stealth from the edge.... all much better don´t you think? the
only thing the 10cap guy does better is call the great beast in one
action... nothing discipline cards and/or diablerie cant do for the
others... Just as a sdie question, there are no new political actions
are there?

Messages.Author: Pat Ricochet
Messages.Body:
> I think you hit the nail on the head. You influence
> Huitzipochtliziseroticabarneyrubblefruitypebbles out and immediately Minion
> Tap him and use his special to do an additional master action then play Call
> the Great Beast. Free uber vampire!!

Almost free...you can only Tap Huitzilopokeyslamaramadingdangboom for 8,
so he has 2 Blood, then paying 1 pool for the Master phase right away
(Fragment of the Book of Nod or the Barrens, for discarding all the other
Great Beasts), 1 blood for the Call the Great Beast action, and then he
needs the last blood so he doesn't have to hunt, but can put on the last
ritual counter (after paying a second pool).

But, the Great Beast can act right away, in a sense saving you an
action! If you feeling really "loopy," I guess you choose Fortitude as a
discipline, Clan Impersonate[0] to Baali, Freak Drive, Call the Great Beast
YOURSELF, Freak Drive, put a counter on it, Freak Drive, (D) Kill someone,
Freak Drive, Bleed for 3...whatever. The point is that it looks like the
Great Beast (if the text GreySeer posted is actually correct) can have it's
own call, and since it burns upon putting the last ritual counter on it, it
will never contest itself.

It would give you something to do with the other 7 Call the Great Beasts
you put in the deck (to make it show up in your opening hand), anyway. =)

[0] Pointless extra spice; add 3 Clandestine Contracts and 3 Provisions, to
have another clan to bother changing to with those extra CI's.

--
Pat Ricochet
Soul Jar'rn Fool of Atlanta

If you had 12 Huitzicalifragilisticexpialidociouses, they'd make a
great crypt. Influence one out, next turn put a Fortitude master on
him, equip with the Soul Gem, Freak Drive and then Summon the Great
Beast. H . . . leaves, Great Beast arrives, new H . . . arrives. The
new H . . . also Summons the Great Beast while the Great Beast bleeds
or rushes or whatever. Next turn, put a Fortitude master on the new H
. . ., who then puts the final ritual counter on Summon the Great
Beast. The new new H . . . then Summons the Great Beast while the two
Great Beasts bleed or rush or whatever.

(Assuming Call the Great Beast works the way the spoiler we've seen
says.)

Sure, the infernal cost of the Great Beasts will be expensive in the
long run, but you need only spend 10 pool on bringing out vampires.
Too bad the cards are all so rare; very few people will have the cards
they need to make this deck.

And 3 superiors... how about Necromancy and Possessing the vampire
straight back into play?

Or adding a Soul Gem and getting the next man out free?

I think the key is in adding one discipline card onto the
Unpronouncable One, making him an 11, bringing out the Great Beast in
one fell swoop.

First Master - add (I dunno!) Skillcard Fortitude.
First action - Soul Gem.

Second Master - Minion Tap for Lots
Second Action - Call the Great Beast

Third Master - Redeem the Lost Soul
Third action... who cares!

So, net effect is a FREE 9 cap uberhosebeastmonstergitfacedwonder who
has his Infernalism set up for ages to come. Only threat is the
Banishment angle...

Martin "Filthy" Cubberley was working on a crazy way of screwing your
prey...

Add Fortitude and Obfuscate master skillcards to your preys biggest
vampire. When he is fat enough, Mind Rape. Clan Imp to Baali. Freak
Drive. Call the Great Beast. Burn him / her. If it doesn't happen
straight away, keep stealing to add counters. Much Joy if your prey
influences Arika or Stanislava...

I personally thought it would work better with Temptation. Ah well...

DH
